_note: Labelled eval set for the shock_parser agent. Each item: a news text and the expected shock type (or null when irrelevant) with magnitude bounds. Scored by run_evals.py: type accuracy, magnitude-in-range rate, false-positive rate on irrelevant items.

items.text: Brent crude jumps 35% in a week after Strait of Hormuz shipping disruption; Singapore pump prices expected to rise sharply.
LTA confirms the Circle Line Stage 6 will open on 12 December, closing the loop and cutting journeys between Marina Bay and HarbourFront.
NEA warns of a prolonged hot spell with daily maximum temperatures of 35–36°C expected over the next two weeks.
Meteorological Service Singapore forecasts an unusually wet northeast monsoon with flash floods likely in low-lying areas.
A regional gas supply outage forces Singapore gencos to run older oil-fired units, raising grid emissions temporarily.
MOH reports a new respiratory virus wave; schools move to home-based learning and offices urged to let staff work from home.
Singapore Zoo welcomes twin red panda cubs.
A new bubble tea chain opens 10 outlets in Orchard Road malls.
Government announces ERP 2.0 gantry rates unchanged for the next quarter.
Diesel and petrol prices fall 8% as global oil markets ease.
Haze from regional fires pushes PSI into the unhealthy range; residents advised to reduce outdoor activity.
Thomson-East Coast Line Stage 5 opening delayed by a year due to testing issues.
